id="I-TNLLBIKghRffwVaEJ6-72" value="<h1 style="margin-top: 0px;">Scene Loading</h1><p></p><ol><li>When player is in a <b>region</b> scene, it's ajoining transition scenes must also be id="I-TNLLBIKghRffwVaEJ6-73" value="<h1 style="margin-top: 0px;">Transition scenes</h1><p></p><ul><li>small scenes which connect regions</li><li>region scenes should not be visible from transition scenes, OR the transition scene should contain<br>copies of the visible assets OR other placeholders&nbsp;</li><li>all other scenes should be unloaded</li><li>LOS needs to be blocked between all exits</li></ul><p></p>" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;rounded=0;" vertex="1" parent="I-TNLLBIKghRffwVaEJ6-1"> <mxGeometry x="1654" y="314" width="616" height="150" as="geometry"
